## A and B op sets chosen SEPARATELY
An order-free pair needs only ONE of its two orientations encodable,
so the A set and the B set need not match.  |A|x|B| is the codepoint
cost, and these are single-tile: compare against biclique_tiling's
b>0 splits, which buy shape at the price of block structure.
